units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:7:6">Y. Erub. V, 23ᵃ</cite> top <he>לשם דייר</he> as a lodging place; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="D00518"><he>דְּיוֹרִים</he></cite>, <he>דְּיוֹרִין</he>.
